knobs.name: hookScale0
knobs.what: the lit mark at the start, as a fraction of its size at the end of the push-in

knobs.name: pushT0
knobs.what: s: the 4 s push toward the mark starts (the camera is still before it)

knobs.name: pushT1
knobs.what: s: the push-in ends on the mark at its full size

knobs.name: hookEnd
knobs.what: s: the headline words are gone by this second (they fade over 0.7 s before it)

knobs.name: hookSize
knobs.what: sheet units: the two headline words (display face, must-read)

knobs.name: hookY
knobs.what: sheet units: baseline of the headline words

knobs.name: glowR
knobs.what: the lit mark's glow radius, in mark widths (kept inside the panel)

knobs.name: litT0
knobs.what: s: the mark starts to light

knobs.name: litT1
knobs.what: s: the mark is fully lit

knobs.name: ruler0
knobs.what: s: the microwave-second ruler draws under the mark

knobs.name: rulerDy
knobs.what: sheet units: the ruler sits this far below the mark's centre

knobs.name: q0
knobs.what: s: the 0.24 Wh readout lands (the first count)

knobs.name: q0Size
knobs.what: sheet units: the 0.24 Wh readout (display face, must-read)

knobs.name: micro0
knobs.what: s: the microwave row of the legend and the filled part of the ruler appear

knobs.name: bulb0
knobs.what: s: the bulb row of the legend appears

knobs.name: ladT0
knobs.what: s: the log zoom starts (rung 10^0 holds first)

knobs.name: dwell
knobs.what: s: hold per rung (a caption lands in it)

knobs.name: move
knobs.what: s: time between rungs (ease cubic on log10 n)

knobs.name: budget
knobs.what: marks drawn one by one up to this many; past it, tiles (module LOD)

knobs.name: tile
knobs.what: cells per tile side past the budget (the module's batch factor is its square)

knobs.name: rungLag
knobs.what: s: after a rung arrives, the energy readout lands (the count is read first)

knobs.name: cntSize
knobs.what: sheet units: the running count (display face, must-read)

knobs.name: enSize
knobs.what: sheet units: the energy readouts (display face, must-read)

knobs.name: panelSize
knobs.what: sheet units: the square panel the crowd lives in (the ruler is a third of it)

knobs.name: panelY
knobs.what: sheet units: top of the panel

knobs.name: panelDensity
knobs.what: pixel density of the panel texture (1 = softer, cheaper)

knobs.name: swapT0
knobs.what: s: the whole 10^5 field starts to shrink into ONE tile (the tile swap)

knobs.name: swapDur
knobs.what: s: length of the swap

knobs.name: t2T0
knobs.what: s: second tier zoom starts (one tile to 100,000 tiles)

knobs.name: t2T1
knobs.what: s: second tier zoom ends on the full site-day

knobs.name: tileFill
knobs.what: share of a cell a tile mark fills in the second tier

knobs.name: siteAt
knobs.what: s: the 100 MW site-day readout (2.4 GWh) lands

knobs.name: billionAt
knobs.what: s: the 10 billion queries readout lands (after the 100,000 tiles)

knobs.name: worldT0
knobs.what: s: hard cut to the world's grid

knobs.name: terrT0
knobs.what: s: hard cut to the terrain

knobs.name: plateCols
knobs.what: cells across the world's grid plate (rows follow from the grid size, one cell per TWh)

knobs.name: cell
knobs.what: world units: one cell of the plate (and the edge of a mark's box)

knobs.name: boxFill
knobs.what: share of a cell a mark's box fills

knobs.name: blockCols
knobs.what: marks per row of the block of 415 (rows follow)

knobs.name: towerFoot
knobs.what: boxes along one side of a tower's square footprint

knobs.name: towerGap
knobs.what: world units: spacing of the four towers

knobs.name: plateRes
knobs.what: texture pixels per plate cell

knobs.name: gridAlpha
knobs.what: opacity of the grey cells of the rest of the world's grid

knobs.name: ambient
knobs.what: ambient light on the boxes (0-255)

knobs.name: keyLight
knobs.what: key light on the boxes (0-255)

knobs.name: wLeg0
knobs.what: s: the legend (one mark = one TWh; grey = the rest) appears

knobs.name: cinT0
knobs.what: s: the first of the 415 marks lands in the block

knobs.name: cinT1
knobs.what: s: the last mark lands (the count reads 415 by then)

knobs.name: cinGrow
knobs.what: s: a mark takes this long to rise to its height

knobs.name: pctAt
knobs.what: s: the share pin appears on the block (after the pull-back settles; 6 s after the count)

knobs.name: regStagger
knobs.what: share of the regroup the last mark waits before leaving

knobs.name: regLift
knobs.what: world units: the hop a mark makes in flight

knobs.name: towT0
knobs.what: s: the first tower count pins (after the turn settles)

knobs.name: towStep
knobs.what: s: between one tower's pin and the next

knobs.name: pctRegAt
knobs.what: s: the first share replaces a tower count (counts first)

knobs.name: checkAt
knobs.what: s: the check line (187 + 104 + 62 + 62 = 415) appears

knobs.name: terrSize
knobs.what: world units: width of the terrain (40 columns)

knobs.name: terrZ
knobs.what: the terrain's depth (rows) as a share of its width scale; a view choice, no cell changes

knobs.name: terrH
knobs.what: world units: height of the taller end of the fixed scale

knobs.name: terrMax
knobs.what: percent at the top of the fixed height scale (the same for every mesa)

knobs.name: terrSlab
knobs.what: world units: depth of the section's floor under the terrain

knobs.name: contours
knobs.what: contour intervals over the height scale (0 = off; unlabelled)

knobs.name: terrAmb
knobs.what: ambient light on the terrain

knobs.name: terrKey
knobs.what: key light on the terrain

knobs.name: revealDur
knobs.what: s: the terrain's rows count in over this long after the cut

knobs.name: namesAt
knobs.what: s: the place names pin (after the crane settles)

knobs.name: cutStartCol
knobs.what: column the section cut starts at (the left edge)

knobs.name: cutIeT0
knobs.what: s: the section cut starts to travel to Ireland

knobs.name: cutIeT1
knobs.what: s: the cut stops at Ireland (a real column)

knobs.name: ieGwhAt
knobs.what: s: Ireland's GWh pins at the cut

knobs.name: iePctAt
knobs.what: s: Ireland's share replaces the GWh (5 s after it)

knobs.name: ieTimesAt
knobs.what: s: the "15 times" pin replaces the share

knobs.name: cutUsT0
knobs.what: s: the cut starts to travel to the United States (the Ireland pin is off one second before)

knobs.name: cutUsT1
knobs.what: s: the cut stops at the United States

knobs.name: usTwhAt
knobs.what: s: the US TWh pins at the cut

knobs.name: usPctAt
knobs.what: s: the US share replaces the TWh

knobs.name: usHalfAt
knobs.what: s: the "about half of 2025 growth" pin replaces the share

knobs.name: dimT0
knobs.what: s: the terrain dims for Monday and the pins go

knobs.name: dim
knobs.what: how far the terrain dims on Monday (share of the ground colour laid over it)

knobs.name: endFade
knobs.what: s: the Monday text fades out (gone 0.5 s later, before the CETI card at 150 s covers the page)

knobs.name: monQ0
knobs.what: s: the question appears

knobs.name: monY
knobs.what: sheet units: baseline of "Per what?" (the second line is 56 below it)

knobs.name: monSize
knobs.what: sheet units: "Per what?" (display face)

knobs.name: monSize2
knobs.what: sheet units: the second line of the question (display face)

knobs.name: honestAt
knobs.what: s: the honest-limits line appears on stage

knobs.name: honestY
knobs.what: sheet units: baseline of the first honest line (it is three lines)

knobs.name: honestSize
knobs.what: sheet units: the honest-limits line (mono, secondary: floor 14)

knobs.name: labHold
knobs.what: frames a pin must be pushed before it hides (gl-labels hysteresis)

knobs.name: labLeader
knobs.what: sheet units: pin leader length

knobs.name: labMax
knobs.what: most pins on screen at once (gl-labels maxShown)
